messages:
Maria G: CI red on PR #6123 — image push to registry failed on last step. Error: 'manifest signed but chunk 3 missing (416)'. Pushing via buildkite job 2174. Any quick ideas?
CI-bot: buildkite/job/2174 — stage: publish-image — status: failed
CI-bot: [log]
  uploading layer sha256:abc123...
  ... chunk upload: 416 Range Not Satisfiable
  manifest signed, finalizing -> 500
Lukas H: hmm, 416 suggests chunk offset mismatch. Could be registry dropped range header. Did we rotate creds recently?
Maria G: creds were rotated yesterday afternoon (k8s secret). Build uses service account token from vault.
SRE-Oncall: Checking registry health... no incident in last 24h. Asking registry logs for the push trace.
DevOps: @Maria can you re-run the job with env DOCKER_CHUNK_SIZE=5242880 and DIAGNOSTIC_PUSH=1? sometimes changing chunk size works around proxies.
Maria G: re-run queued: buildkite/job/2174 -> rerun by Maria G
CI-bot: rerun started. Note: this will use cached layers; to force fresh, set FORCE_REBUILD=1
Jon P: if it repros consistently, can we bisect to the Dockerfile change? maybe a new ADD/COPY changed ordering causing big layer that triggers chunking edge case.
Maria G: good call — last Dockerfile change was pr #6078 (flattened layers). I can try reverting that commit in a branch to test.
SRE-Oncall: registry logs show intermittent 502s from edge proxy at same timestamps as first failure. I'm opening a ticket with infra.
Lukas H: also add --max-concurrent-uploads=1 to kaniko runner as a quick test.
Maria G: rerun finished — still failed with same 416. I'll try a forced rebuild with smaller chunk size and single upload.
CI-bot: buildkite/job/2174-rerun -> failed again: same 416. Attaching snippet: 'PUT /v2/redwood/images/blobs/uploads/...?digest=sha256:... 416 Range Not Satisfiable'
DevOps: can you paste the full curl/PUT sequence from the worker logs? sometimes proxy strips Content-Range.
Maria G: pasted logs in thread: ```PUT /v2/... 416
Headers: Content-Range: bytes 10485760-20971519/31457280
X-Request-Id: req-9a7
```
Jon P: sounds like client is sending ranges beyond reported total. Might be our kaniko chunking math. Which kaniko version?
Maria G: kaniko v1.9.3 in CI image.
Lukas H: kaniko v1.10 had a fix for chunk math. Try upgrading kaniko image in the pipeline.
Maria G: I'll try update to v1.10 in a test pipeline and re-run. If that fixes, we'll do a canary release to runners.
SRE-Oncall: opening infra ticket about edge proxy; mark as followup.
Maria G: thanks all, will report back with outcome. :thumbsup:
